PRECISE ART REVISION. Minimal contemporary technical printing on PURE WHITE backdrop. Draw only isolated physical specimens, flat folded translucent vellum and simple solid-color geometric registration marks. ALL visible paper surfaces must be perfectly clean, ONLY the named words. Absolutely ban hands, arms, fingers, people, gloves, magnifiers held by anyone, check marks, pseudo text lines, horizontal filler strokes, gears, laptops, wax seals, ornamental frames. Depict independent checkers as three differently shaped colored optical prisms independently aligned to the same proof strip. Keep the entire folio small and fully visible with broad white margins. Flat areas, large lettering, airy mechanical detail.
Create one beautiful professional technical-book editorial illustration with white paper, 1200 by 630 landscape. A printmaker’s folio opens diagonally across the sheet: two separately typeset statements align in a translucent registration window; a stitched proof volume yields a sealed export strip checked by independent readers. Show the Mathlib statement, matching theorem, repeated builds and proof-checker agreement as separate evidence. Avoid claims about independent discovery or a proof generated by AI. Use Oblique registration view and Burgundy and slate. Depict only the source facts: The statement was compared against the theorem proved in Alpöge’s library using two independent tools. Recompilations returned the same raw proof export; multiple checkers examined the export. The community distinguishes machine verification from explaining the mathematical ideas. Preserve very large print labels with a 72 px inset; source detail on every meaningful surface. Required visible text exactly once each: Mathlib statement | Library theorem | Same statement | Rebuilt library | Raw proof export | Independent checkers | Matching evidence | Machine verification. Draw only the named connections at object ports, separate caveat, no caption strip, no badge wall, no other text or frame. Geometry below is for art direction and must never appear printed.
